defaultTagline: Visual app builder with real backends
title: Welcome to your installation.
intro: Three quick steps and you're ready to build. Everything you set here can be changed later from the admin panel.
adminBody: This account will have full access. Save the password somewhere safe.
setupCodeHint: Your installer displays this code. It is also saved as INSTALL_TOKEN in .env. To resume setup, use the same owner email and password.
name: Name
aiBody: At least one is needed to use the AI Scaffold or Designer. You can skip if you only want the visual editor for now.

providerHelp.openai: Use a hosted or local model for the AI builder, Designer, and editor.
providerHelp.claude-cli: Uses a command-line AI tool installed and signed in on this server, for every AI feature. See docs/deploy/plesk.md.
providerHelp.skip: Use the visual editor + templates only. AI features will be disabled until you configure a provider in admin settings.

localHint: For a local model, use the exact model ID your server provides. In Docker, reach the host with host.docker.internal. A local server may not require an API key.
apiKey: API key (optional for a local server)
cliPath: AI agent program path (blank to find it automatically)
brandBody: All optional. Defaults give you {app}'s look. You can change any of this any time from the Admin → Brand settings.
footer: Powered by {app} · You're installing on this machine. Anyone with admin can re-run brand setup from <mono>/admin/settings</mono>.

api.adminFields: Enter your setup code, name, email, and a password of at least 12 characters.
api.badToken: The setup code doesn't match. Copy INSTALL_TOKEN from your installation's .env file.
api.hasOwner: Setup already has an owner. To resume, enter the same owner email and password.
api.signIn: Sign in as the setup owner first.
api.badBaseUrl: Use an HTTP(S) base URL without credentials or query parameters.
